nom: The INKEY List Beta Hydroxy Acid Blemish + Blackhead Serum

avis.texte: I noticed that I had lots of blackheads on my nose which led me to purchasing this product. I used it for less than 1 week and was able to draw up a deep/old blackhead that I had trouble removing in the past. So great for the price! Its easy to use too, its a squeeze bottle that dispenses product drop by drop.
Great serum to apply before the omega water cream. My skin is hydrated, and plumped up.
Honestly, I haven't used much yet. I only apply once in a week.

Due to Working in a dusty environment my pores would be clogged and blackheads becoming an issue particularly around my nose. This serum has completely changed my skin, applied morning and night it has helped clear my skin and now it's much brighter and clearer.

avis.titre: Smoother skin with smaller and less clogged pores
avis.texte: I love texture of this product - watery and so easy to apply! You will need just really a small amount to apply on a whole face. It also very well blends under my sunscreen lotion, no peeling or so. Regarding the effect, I like how my pores look smaller and I have generally less clogged pores, even though I have some breakout, from time to time. But it's very hard for me to judge the effect of the separate product, as I currently also use retinol and azelaic acid as another active ingredients in my routine.

I switched over to this BHA from a different brand bc I wanted less of the cream type serums, and the price point and clear gel of this one seemed promising. I've got persistent acne and pretty oily skin so a good bha is indispensable This has been so nice. It doesn't irritate, it makes my skin feel so nice just after putting it on, and it absorbs quickly without making me feel all sticky. And when I wake up in the morning I can see a decrease in my general blemishes and such. So good. My only complaint: it's so little. Please Inkey PLEASE make a jumbo size tube. I get two of these little ones at a time and it still feels like it goes so fast! The little one is nice for travel, but I wouldn't mind a big honking tube. If you want to make a gallon size I'll buy it, no question.
Very satisfied with this product! Acne got way better after 2 weeks of use,

I use this after the hyaluronic acid serum and before the niacinamide serum. Works well with both. Doesn't cause drying of the skin or production of excess oil. Have definitely noticed reduced pore visibility.

avis.titre: It does the job really well
avis.texte: Very good product but limiting sun exposure is very important while using it

avis.titre: Small differences will use it more
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for two week at first, it caused some small breakouts, but I'm giving it a chance and hoping things improve with time. My skin feels more hydrated but it didn't help with my blackheads yet.

BHA serum is one product that has remained a constant in my skincare routine, even as I've made changes. While there are many different AHA and BHA serums out there, this one is the most effective for me. It has significantly smoothed my skin's texture, reduced bumps and small pimples, and it has also even prevented major breakouts.

This is my favourite product. I have been using this for about a year and half and it has changed my skin. I used to have constant blackheads and clogged pores on my nose and chin and this cleared out my pores like nothing I have used before. I never get breakouts anymore and it doesn't dry my skin out. I highly recommend this product!

I started using this product after getting disappointing results from another brand of SA solution, which left me oily after a few hours. I switched to this serum and the srbacious filaments are less noticable and disappearing, my skin texture is more even, and breakouts have been at bay. I haven't been oily, and my skin feels lovely. Will definitely purchase again. :)
i did not feel the serum has helped me with black heads on my nose and chin
I really wished this would work for me but it didn't. I still have blackheads that just won't budge it is frustrating.... I liked the texture more than the paulas choice one though.
I haven't noticed a difference in my skin at all. Feels nice and has no smell.
I love this serum, I apply it on lazy days after another serum. No more oily skin and large pores. Skin feels so much better

This serum is great! I was using a different brand of this and thought i'd try this, since I have loved everything else from inkey. It is great! It clears my skin, but doesn't leave me feeling tight or dry. Totally recommend.
My sensitive skin loves this exfoliator, I use it twice a week and I can see an incredible difference! My skin is not tight and hormonal breakouts are visibly reduced.
I use this serum daily for over 3 years now & along with their other products have a great routine for my oily skin which has drastically improved !!
I'm already seeing some results after a few weeks, my blackheads are starting to clear and you only need a couple drops at a time so it's very economical.

I have only just introduced this product into my routine. I can see that it has cleared up my little pimples but still getting a few big spots. Think im going through the purging phrase so sticking with it
I do suffer with blackheads on my nose and this has helped, I still get them but they have lessened and I will continue to use this forever I think!!
I have quite a few blackheads all over my face and this along with the glycolic acid helps so much
I was using this on a daily basis, and my skin cleared up so fast. the second i stopped using it i started getting blemishes again
I'm really loving this serum ! It helps to control my breakouts and it's safe for my sensitive skin and doesn't break me off!
Actually, I use it just around my nose because of my blackheads and it works definitely before I use it. I clean my nose and after that I use it and it works.

I have had blackheads since I was a teenager. I decided to buy this because recently my blackheads were making my nose feel bumpy and rough to the touch. After using this serum once in the morning for about 2-3 weeks, my nose is smooth and my blackheads are significantly smaller! I only use it on my nose, so it feels like the bottle is going to last a long time.
Great for blackheads, but for sebaceous filaments I needed other products to completely get rid of them.
Amazing! I would purchase again! The botthe is too small though, it would be better to make a bigger version.
I use it in my T-Zone. It is not sticky and it sinks right into my skin! It you tend to have oily areas , this product is game changer! Such a great price too!
Works like a charm every time. I usually use it with a pimple patch and by morning it's all gone

i bought this to unclog my skin and while it does brighten my face, i did break out with a big hurtful pimple on my cheek. i know it takes time for these kinds of serums to do its job but im hoping the breakout wasn't from this (i was using another essence with this but stopped since the breakout to see what it was that caused it). finally, IT STINKS!!!! like expired milk or vomit! like what is up with that! also this feels kind of heavy on my skin and makes it very oily/shiny which is why i only put it on in the PM.

Two orders ago, it was light brown and smelled like coffee. This last order it's clear and smells like Parmesan cheese. I'm not a fan of this small batch inconsistency. When it comes to the BHA I'm going to stick with Paula's. I still love their niacinamide serum and the Omega water cream. But I'm not buying my salicylic acid from here anymore.
the texture is perfect but the bottle is like half empty but love the product

i find my skin is much smoother, clearer and less oily the morning after use ( i use this at night ) and as long as not paired with other harsh products so soon it doesn't irritate the skin and this is great for me considering i'm super pale and have very sensitive skin so it's very easy for my skin to look red and blotchy.
Not sure if this one is doing very much, been using it for a couple of months but I still have some acne and blackheads/lumpy skin
Love it. Goes on well, don't need to use much, not sticky, skin is doing well. Fairly sensitive skin has not reacted. I've tried other brands and this is my favourite.

Without being too thick, this serum really brightens me up and gives me a good glow before applying my moisturizer. While layering different serums, its nice texture helps to not have things feeling like they're piling up on my face!
This is my first time using this product from the Inkey list, I just started using it but so far so good, I seem to be getting less break outs and blackouts. Another win IMO

I love how soft these BHA's make my skin!! I only use them maybe 1-2 times a week but i notice a huge improvement in my skin the morning after using them! No irritation or dryness to my skin after use!
I use this product twice a day and it has really helped my skin.
It cleared up my nose blackheads! You need to be patient with it though, I used it for about a month before I started seeing results.

avis.titre: I can visibly see smaller pores!
avis.texte: The texture is lovely, and I definitely can see a difference in my pores.
When I see the word 'acid' I assume it will damage my sensitive skin. Follow 1nkey's advice on the product, it says on the box where and at what part in your beauty regime you can apply it. Love it!
i've used this as a first serum for a while now and have noticed a difference in the size and visibility of my pores. this also helps with breakouts in the t-zone area
Seen a difference to my skin in the first few days!! Wonderful
It's helping me with stubborn acne on the side of my face and chin. I have noticed a difference and will keep on using it.
When I have a breakout I use this in my nighttime routine. It works great.
It's fine but a very small amount. Apply with finger tips to avoid wasting on cotton wool pad.

Okay so I've struggled with congested skin and blackheads for as long as I can remember literally but this is perfection it really helps and I can't be without it now it really has transformed my skin I really noice when I'm out now.

avis.titre: No issues with my rosacea-prone skin
avis.texte: I started using this product recently, so a bit early to judge the full result, but it seems that the serum helps to slow down the blackheads apparition. The pores however do not seem shrunk, so I suggest adding a dedicated toner product for that purpose. One big positive side is that I can use the product without any issues on my rosacea breakouts-prone skin.
PCOS haver, adult acne, blackheads, big pores and terrible texture. Give this beauty a month with Niamicide, Hyaluronic acid and a good day and night cleansing, and see the results!
Helped my with my pores, definitely a visible difference there

Great for fighting blackheads and getting a light exfoliation. I don't use it everyday, only when I feel I need extra exfoliation or if I notice some stubborn blackheads, and I can definitely see its effects the next morning.

Was definitely a bit skeptical using this as I've tried nearly everything to get rid of blackheads on my nose but I've been using this for around a month pretty much daily (AM) - I've noticed a massive positive difference especially on my nose - blackheads are hardly visible, the pores have definitely got smaller and my skin genuinely looks so clear now. So happy that something has finally worked for me .. I'll be buying more!!
I love my BHA evenings! This product applied after the Salicylic acid cleanser and niacinamide serum is love for my skin! Just try the combo! Thank me later :-)
Good texture, no scent or parfum, gel-like consistency. Non sticky and feels okay in oily skin. Still waiting to see results.
This product was fab did everything is says drys really quickly in my skin considering it's an oily serum

The Inkey List BHA and Paula's Choice BHA are both effective exfoliating products that contain salicylic acid. However, the Inkey List BHA is more budget-friendly and offers a slightly gentler formula that may be suitable for those with sensitive skin.
Had a facial and they commented how clean and empty my pores where! I owe it to this
i use this as a spot treatment at night sometimes and i love it so much!!

My absolute favourite serum. I've had allergic reaction to something (not this or skincare) and had a bad flare up on my cheeks and within a few days this had really help and calmed it all down. If I ever have the start of a spot coming I use this on a night and by the morning it's gone. best ever!
This is really good at helping heal my cystic hormonal acne. Gentle, doesn't bother my skin, and effective!
I have ance-prone 35 years old skin and I can't imagine not having this serum . It is affordable and it works

avis.titre: My acne-prone, sensitive skin loves it
avis.texte: Recently started using this in my routine and after a month I began seeing clearer skin and smaller pores on my face!

avis.titre: Easy to use!  Goes on nice and easy.
avis.texte: Seems to be working to unblock some of the pores on my face and nose, too soon to tell if it totally stops it. Excited to find out :) All my other products work great, so I'm sure this will also.
most of the 2% bha serums and toners are too harsh for my skin but i tolerate this one pretty well. also looks small but a little goes a long way
Gives my skin such a nice glow I mix it in with my moisturer idk if your supposed to do that but the results are amazing so glowy and healthy looking

I have gotten my acne under control but used to suffer bad. I usually get acne that pops up with my period but ever since I added this during that time of month or when I see little acne popping up, my face stays clear or clears the few pimples there. I do not use this daily, but it does help those times of the month. Make sure not to mix this with retinol.

avis.titre: simple product that is highly effective
avis.texte: I struggle with frequent breakouts, especially on the cheeks and jawline area. I've also got sensitive skin that reacts badly to most skincare products. I've tried many products and this one clears up my skin the fastest. I even noticed a huge difference overnight. I recommend using this or the Salicylic Acid Cleanser, which also helped my skin a lot.
Bought for my kids to combat blackheads and clear teenage bumpy skin - it works!
The serum has a great consistency and has certainly been helpful for me

avis.titre: Great in combination with other products!
avis.texte: I use the BHA Serum 2 times a week in the evening. Combined with other products, it definitely helped me to achieve a much clearer skin with less breakouts! Can recommend. Tip: it becomes sticky when added too much, so be careful to just use one or two drops for the whole face.
use it daily and do not need to use any other exfoliator, it does it all

This is something that I will use until the end of time, it's amazing! I put it on my spots and the next morning they're either completely gone (for small spots) or significantly smaller (for bigger spots). Absolutely amazing product
